   static long[] pow;

   {
      Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
      String input = sc.nextLine();
      int N = input.length();
      int[] arr = new int[N];
      for(int i=0; i < N; i++)
         arr[i] = input.charAt(i)-'0';
      pow = new long[16];
      pow[0] = 1L;
      for(int i=1; i <= 15; i++)
         pow[i] = pow[i-1]*10;
      long start = Long.parseLong(input);
      System.out.println(solve(start));

            return 4;

            return 5;
         else if(x == 7)
            return 6;
         else
            return (int)x;

      long boof = 0L;

         boof += pow[i];

            res = Math.min(res, len*d+solve(Math.abs(boof-x)));

   }
